_comment: Thirteen tracked sources. 'feedUrls' is empty by default for every one — no URL here is guessed; add each source's real RSS/Atom feed to activate it, no code change needed. Each source also carries the domainTags a routed opportunity/content-queue/product-backlog entry should use.

sources.name: EU AI Act
sources._note: e.g. the EU Commission's AI Office news feed or EUR-Lex's own publication feed for the AI Act, once identified.

sources.name: ISO 42001
sources._note: ISO's own news feed, or a certification body's ISO 42001 update feed.

sources.name: NIST AI RMF
sources._note: NIST's AI RMF resource-centre feed, once identified.

sources.name: DORA
sources._note: ESAs' (EBA/ESMA/EIOPA) DORA news feed, once identified.

sources.name: GDPR
sources._note: EDPB or a national DPA's enforcement/guidance feed, once identified.

sources.name: CBUAE
sources._note: Central Bank of the UAE's own news/circulars feed, once identified.

sources.name: RBI

sources.name: Microsoft AI
